title: Gemini 3.8 Flash against 3.7 Flash
summary: Same price, same limits, three weeks apart. Google leads with a customer saying 3.8 Flash completed more than three times as many tasks. Independent indexes show a real but much smaller gain in agentic work, flat coding, and a slower first token.

sources.label: Introducing Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.8 Flash Cyber
Gemini 3.8 Flash guide separating vendor and independent figures
Coverage quoting Google's note on token use at higher effort

claims.text: Completed more than three times as many tasks as 3.7 Flash
claims.claimedBy: Customer quote on Google's Flash page
claims.scopeNote: The quote comes from one company's document-heavy evaluation. The reference is an independent agentic index, so it is a proxy, not a replication.

claims.text: Agentic video understanding uses up to 88% fewer tokens on long-form content
claims.noRefNote: No independent measurement found. Build a long-video task set and run it live; note the claim says up to 88%, so a typical figure will be lower.

observations.text: Google itself cautions that the model may use more tokens to maximise performance, especially at higher effort levels, so cost per task can rise even at an unchanged price.
Time to first token got worse, from 12.0 to 13.2 seconds, even though streaming speed rose from 279 to 299 tokens per second.
The independent coding index barely moved (76.1 to 76.3), while the overall Intelligence Index rose from 56 to 59.
Both models are on introductory pricing of $0.75/$3.75 that rises to $1.50/$7.50 on 1 January 2027.

livePack.note: Runs the 15 starter tasks plus 7 multi-step efficiency tasks. Add tasks from your own work before trusting a verdict.

extraTasks.prompt: A train leaves at 09:40 and arrives at 13:05 the same day. How many minutes is the journey? Answer with the number only.
How many positive integers below 100 are divisible by 3 or by 5? Answer with the number only.
If today is Wednesday, what day of the week will it be 100 days from today? Answer with the day name only.
A shop gives 20% off, then a further 10% off the reduced price. What is the total discount as a percentage of the original price? Answer with the number only.
Which is the largest of these: 3/7, 0.45, 4/9, 0.43? Answer with the value exactly as written in the list.
Return only JSON with keys "po" and "total" (total as a number, in rupees) for this order: "PO-7781 for 12 units at Rs 1,250 each."
How many vowels (a, e, i, o, u) are in the word "transformation"? Answer with the number only.
